review: I like the one-mechanic-per-stage structure: each stage has its own palette and hazard, and Gauntlet recombines all of them fairly. But the curve is broken at Saw Mill. A 37% pass rate at stage 3, after 63% on Spike Garden, is a wall, and the saws float at jump height over flat ground with no safe first example. First Steps kills 29 of 100 at its spike clusters, which is too harsh for a tutorial. Ferry Lines gives all three players the same 12 seconds, so the platforms dictate the pace. Crumble Bridge, Spring Loaded and Laser Gate teach well and their deaths are readable.
best: Gauntlet recombines every taught mechanic in short readable beats and ends on a ferry to a high goal.
worst: Saw Mill is a stage-3 difficulty wall at 37% pass with saws introduced without a safe first encounter.
